sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the conditional IA/IA Super applicability, requires a valid construction-stage date for applicable ships, applies the pre-1-September-2003 branch only when appropriate, enforces the allowed 2017 methods, and checks the inclusive assessment deadline using the delivery year. Owners, canonical terms, datatypes, and units are correct.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the global sh:in restriction to iceClassIa and iceClassIaSuper: non-IA/IA Super ships are outside this conditional requirement and must not fail the shape. Keep iceClass as the applicability input, but enforce the IA/IA Super alternatives only inside the applicability/compliance logic.
